create.name: Zentrum für Buddhismus
create.bio:
The Zentrum für Buddhismus, also called Changchub Shenpen Ling, is a meeting place in Bern, Switzerland, for Buddhist practice across traditions. It was set up in 2000 in rooms first fitted out in 1993 by a Tibetan Buddhist group in a converted double garage near the Rosengarten, and it is run by a members' association. Rather than following one teacher, it gives space to several practice groups, among them a Vipassana group, a Zen group, a Plum Village group, a Tibetan study group and a queer sangha, and its teachers follow the ethical code of the Swiss Buddhist Union.

Alongside the weekly sittings it runs introductions to meditation, practice days and week-long courses that fit around daily life, and a monthly Thursday evening talk by authorised teachers from the Theravada, Mahayana and Vajrayana schools, held in person and streamed on Zoom. Activities are funded mainly by dana, with a contribution asked for courses. Recordings of past talks, by teachers such as Fred von Allmen, Akincano Marc Weber, Sylvia Wetzel and Muho, are kept in an online archive and on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Dharmapraxis im Alltag mit Fred von Allmen
courses.description: A week-long course in Bern that fits around daily life: an opening Sunday afternoon with meditation and a talk, weekday evening sessions of sitting and sharing, and a closing Saturday. Taught by Fred von Allmen.

courses.title: Einsichtsdialog-Praxistag mit Irene Bumbacher: Das Geschenk der Freundschaft
courses.description: A one-day Insight Dialogue practice day on the theme of friendship, in which meditation is practised in dialogue with others. Held in German at the centre and led by Irene Bumbacher.

courses.title: Karuna – Mitgefühl: Meditationstag mit Ursula Flückiger
courses.description: A one-day meditation retreat at the centre devoted to karuna, the Buddhist practice of compassion. Led by Ursula Flückiger.

free_resources.title: Archiv mit Aufnahmen (talk archive)
free_resources.description: The centre's archive of recorded public talks from teachers of several Buddhist traditions, mostly in German or Swiss German, with some in English.

free_resources.title: Monthly public talks (Vorträge)
free_resources.description: A Thursday evening talk once a month on everyday life seen through Buddhist teaching, given in Bern and streamed on Zoom. No booking is needed and donations go to the teacher.

free_resources.title: Vipassana Meditationsgruppe Bern
free_resources.description: A weekly Wednesday evening sitting group: an hour of silent meditation followed by a Dhamma input and discussion, with regular visits from monks of Dhammapala monastery and teachers from the Beatenberg meditation centre.
